title: Constrained Edge-Layer Local Search on 20-Layer Stack
scientific_hypothesis: The spectral slope and band-edge performance of the 20-layer alternating stack is limited by interference phase mismatches at the air-coating and coating-substrate interfaces. Constraining optimization to outermost layers (0-3 and 17-19) while fixing interior layers will refine edge performance without destabilizing the verified interior architecture.
design_principle: Local refinement of boundary layers to resolve constructive/destructive interference edge cases while preserving the optimized interior stack that achieved 0.8706 target score.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica (20 finite layers, alternating HfO2/SiO2 starting with HfO2)
design_variables: thicknesses of layers 0-3 and 17-19 (8 layers total)
manufacturing_considerations: ±8 nm thickness tolerance on optimized layers
electron beam evaporation compatible thickness range 50-200 nm
theory_basis: Quarter-wave multilayer stack boundary layer modification principle
Transfer matrix method for phase matching at interfaces
expected_advantages: Faster convergence due to reduced search space
Targets known weakness at spectral band edges
known_risks: May not achieve significant improvement if interior layers also need adjustment
Constrained search may miss global optimum
execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2. Initialize thicknesses from iteration_05 best candidate [108.66, 56.51, 115.65, 58.86, 122.67, 61.23, 130.04, 61.40, 145.56, 62.94, 152.06, 66.95, 130.76, 114.91, 115.44, 130.11, 120.17, 114.78, 52.69, 53.38] nm. Constrain optimization to layers 0-3 and 17-19 only (8 layers), with bounds of ±8 nm from initialization. Fix layers 4-16 at initialization values. Use line-search algorithm with gradient tolerance 1e-6. Evaluate dual-band objective: maximize transmittance in 1000-1700 nm, maximize reflectance in 300-450 nm, normal incidence, unpolarized light. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive for constrained local-search on outermost periodic pairs to refine spectral slope without destabilizing interior stack. Differs from iteration_05 by restricting optimization to edge layers only.
